## [Damaged fixture delivered => only Partial $Credit](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/654413e9e3e4e71eea31b2d0)
I ordered a light fixture and it came damaged. I noticed the damage immediately and I did not even take the fixture out of its original packaging box. I requested to return it and they took it back but did not credit me my shipping charge. This is not a fair policy as the product was damaged.

August 31, 2023

* * *

Useful 1

Share

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 7, 2023

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us, and we genuinely apologize for the dissatisfaction you've experienced with your light fixture. We truly value your input.

In cases of damages, we do require pictures to process a full refund. Regrettably, as no pictures were provided, we treated this as a regular return. However, your satisfaction is important to us, and we'd like to rectify this situation. If you could kindly provide further details about the item you received, we encourage you to reach out to our support team at support@luluandgeorgia.com. We're here to assist you in any way we can.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. We appreciate your feedback, and we're committed to ensuring a better experience for you.
